mapper.select:
/* BmsPrintMapper.selectBmsOutPrintList : 반출신고 출력용 추가 데이터 리스트 */ SELECT B.IN_NO , A.OUT_NO , B.CARRYIN_DATE , A.CARRYOUT_DATE , A.BL_NO , A.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO , B.CD_TYPE , teoa.DROP_YN FROM TB_BMS_OUT A WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN TB_BMS_IN B WITH (NOLOCK) ON A.IN_NO = B.IN_NO LEFT JOIN (SELECT OD_JOB_NO, DROP_YN FROM TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL) teoa ON teoa.OD_JOB_NO = B.OD_JOB_NO WHERE 1=1
AND ${srchNoType} = REPLACE(#{srchNo}, '-', '')

/* BmsPrintMapper.selectBmsInspectPrintList : 검사계획통보 출력용 추가 데이터 리스트 */ SELECT B.IN_NO , A.INSPECT_NO , B.CARRYIN_DATE , A.BL_NO , A.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO , B.CD_TYPE , teoa.DROP_YN FROM TB_BMS_INSPECT A LEFT JOIN TB_BMS_IN B WITH (NOLOCK) ON A.IN_NO = B.IN_NO LEFT JOIN (SELECT OD_JOB_NO, DROP_YN FROM TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL) teoa ON teoa.OD_JOB_NO = B.OD_JOB_NO WHERE 1=1
AND ${srchNoType} = REPLACE(#{srchNo}, '-', '')

/* BmsPrintMapper.selectBmsOutNoticePrintList : 반입통고신고 출력용 추가 데이터 리스트 */ SELECT B.IN_NO , A.OUT_NOTICE_NO , B.CARRYIN_DATE , A.BL_NO , A.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO FROM TB_BMS_OUT_NOTICE A LEFT JOIN TB_BMS_IN B WITH (NOLOCK) ON A.IN_NO = B.IN_NO WHERE 1=1
AND ${srchNoType} = REPLACE(#{srchNo}, '-', '')

/* BmsPrintMapper.selectBmsAbnormalPrintList : 반입물품이상신고 출력용 추가 데이터 리스트 */ SELECT A.ABN_NO , A.ABN_REQ_DATE , A.MBL_NO , A.CUSTOMS_REPORT_NO FROM TB_BMS_ABNORMAL A WHERE 1=1
AND ${srchNoType} = REPLACE(#{srchNo}, '-', '')
